decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the custom-fabricated render-style spouts as a V1 exception to its off-the-shelf sourcing policy.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records both custom stainless-steel spout construction and conformity to the provided rendering.
The candidate already records the source message's CAD-relevant render alignment and customer-facing placard placement; the spout sourcing choice does not otherwise change the layout deliverable.
The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the instruction to match the provided render closely, and the spout sourcing choice adds no separate visual-identity state change.
Selecting custom-fabricated stainless-steel spouts does not necessarily change the requirement to provide a basic wiring plan, and no specific wiring change is established by the client source.
The custom spout sourcing decision leaves the existing leak-prevention constraints valid and unchanged.
The selected spout material and appearance do not modify or remove the existing removability and cleanability requirements.
The source message's branding effect is already represented by a complete same-message MODIFY placing the placard on the customer-facing side.

The acceptance clearly selects custom stainless-steel render-style spouts, but it is unclear whether it also accepts the preceding freelancer proposal for a button-controlled solenoid valve or only the fabrication and appearance choice.
